Sends identify, track, page, group and alias events to a Segment source.

## API key

1. Open [twilio.com](https://www.twilio.com/docs/segment/connections/find-writekey) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** The write key of an HTTP API source, from the source's Settings > API Keys.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add segment
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  segment: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Segment's [API](https://www.twilio.com/docs/segment/connections/sources/catalog/libraries/server/http-api) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show segment` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** 1000 calls a second. Recommended ceiling per workspace; 32 KB per call, 500 KB and 2,500 events per batch.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Segment).
